uqm.title: The Ur-Quan Masters
uqm.contentPolicy: Code is GPL; content has separate Creative Commons/custom terms. Content is not bundled.

chocolate-doom.title: Chocolate Doom
chocolate-doom.contentPolicy: Engine follows upstream free-software licensing. IWAD data remains external.

sdlpop.title: SDLPoP
sdlpop.contentPolicy: Preserve upstream notices. Commercial Prince of Persia data is not bundled.

openjazz.title: OpenJazz
openjazz.contentPolicy: Preserve upstream notices. Jazz Jackrabbit data is external.

nxengine-evo.title: NXEngine-evo (Cave Story)
nxengine-evo.contentPolicy: Engine follows upstream licensing. Cave Story data is external.

neverball.title: Neverball / Neverputt
neverball.contentPolicy: GPL-2.0-or-later. Release bundle carries upstream data, fonts and notices exactly as licensed by upstream.

assaultcube.title: AssaultCube
assaultcube.contentPolicy: Source code is zlib-like. The shipped media uses mixed per-asset licences; do not redistribute game data until its individual/package licence has been checked.

serious-sam-classic.title: Serious Sam Classic (TFE/TSE)
serious-sam-classic.contentPolicy: Engine source is GPL-2.0. Original Serious Sam game data is not open and must be supplied by the user; do not commit or redistribute it.

warzone2100.title: Warzone 2100
warzone2100.contentPolicy: GPL-2.0 project with additional third-party notices and submodules. Preserve COPYING/COPYING.NONGPL/COPYING.README and review submodule/data licences before packaging.

doom3.title: Doom 3 GPL source
doom3.contentPolicy: Engine source is GPL-3.0 with id Software's additional terms in COPYING.txt. Original Doom 3 game data is proprietary and must be user-supplied.
